been offline all day, what did i miss from the people i follow
grounding: The person is signed in and asks about posts from accounts they follow. The right move is to call read_my_timeline. In the test harness that tool returns an error saying the app could not be reached, so a good answer says plainly that it could not read their timeline just now, does not invent timeline contents, and may offer public trending topics as a fallback, clearly labelled as not their timeline. Answering only with trending topics and no attempt to read the timeline is a failure. The four app tools do not exist in the test harness; the copilot's STEPS should record the call as a 'TOOL CALL:' line. Grade on whether it chose the right tool with sensible input and whether the answer matches what that tool would have returned in the test.

did anyone important reply to me today?
grounding: Signed in as @pfrazee.com (Paul Frazee, Bluesky's CTO, about 310,000 followers). Replies to him are public, so the copilot can either call read_my_notifications (returns an error in the test) or look up his recent posts and their replies with the script. 'Important' is vague: a good answer either picks notable repliers by a stated measure (verified, large following, people he follows) or says how it interpreted the word. It must not present a guess as his notifications. The four app tools do not exist in the test harness; the copilot's STEPS should record the call as a 'TOOL CALL:' line. Every handle in the proposal must be a real, active account; check a few with `profile`. It must not say the list has been created.
